# Douyin Game Videos API

Retrieve game video feeds from Douyin web by specifying `count` and an optional `refresh_index` for pagination.

## Use cases

- Browsing gaming video feeds from Douyin.
- Displaying game-related content in external dashboards.
- Paginating through video streams for gaming research.

## Request

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/douyin/web/game-aweme" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"count": "<count>"}'
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `count` | integer | Yes | Number per page, default is 16 |
| `refresh_index` | integer | No | Paging index, default is 1 |

## Notes

- `count` defines the number of items returned per page, defaulting to 16.
- `refresh_index` controls the pagination index, with a default value of 1.

## Pricing

Flat price per call. Failed calls, including lookups whose target does not exist, are not charged.

## Related APIs

- [Douyin Batch Video ID Extraction](/model/douyin/web/all-aweme-id): Extracts video IDs from a list of Douyin video URLs.
- [Douyin sec_user_ids from URLs (Batch)](/model/douyin/web/all-sec-user-id): Extracts Douyin sec_user_id values in bulk from a list of user homepage URLs.
- [Douyin Webcast ID Extraction](/model/douyin/web/all-webcast-id): Extracts webcast IDs from a submitted list of Douyin live room links.
